## Checklist

- [ ] There is an issue for this change, or it only touches documentation or tests.
- [ ] Tests: a positive and a negative case for anything security-relevant.
- [ ] `npm test` passes; `npm run test:e2e` too if the browser side changed.
- [ ] `README.md` (API section), `PROTOCOL.md` and `THREAT-MODEL.md` updated where they are affected.
- [ ] No new dependency, no build step, no application-specific code.
- [ ] New files start with `// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`; no names or author tags.
